name: 33033 · Homestead, FL
findings: ZIP 33033 (Homestead) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 18 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33033 (Homestead) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33033 (Homestead) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
